subTagline: Nairobi's premier strength & conditioning facility — where serious athletes are made.
aboutDescription: Kraft Gym is Nairobi's go-to facility for people who take their fitness seriously. We combine professional-grade equipment, certified coaches, and a community that pushes you beyond limits. Whether you're dropping fat, building muscle, or training for sport — we have the program, the space, and the team to get you there.

services.name: Weight Training
services.desc: Build serious strength with free weights, machines, and expert programming tailored to your goals.

services.name: Cardio
services.desc: Boost endurance and torch calories with treadmills, bikes, rowing machines and more.

services.name: HIIT
services.desc: High-intensity interval training that burns fat long after you leave the gym.

services.name: Yoga & Zumba
services.desc: Recover, stretch, and move with our group yoga and Zumba classes — open to all levels.

trainers.name: James Otieno
trainers.bio: James is a certified strength coach and former national powerlifting champion. He specialises in helping clients build raw, functional strength with correct form and progressive overload principles.

trainers.name: Amina Wanjiku
trainers.bio: Amina is passionate about transforming bodies through high-intensity training and smart nutrition. Her classes are intense, energetic, and always produce results.

trainers.name: Brian Kimani
trainers.bio: Brian works with athletes and active individuals who want to move better, run faster, and recover smarter. His sports-science background gives every session an edge.

trainers.name: Grace Muthoni
trainers.bio: Grace brings calm, precision and deep anatomical knowledge to every yoga and mobility session. Perfect for members recovering from injury or simply wanting to move pain-free.

testimonials.name: Kevin M.
testimonials.text: Joined Kraft Gym 6 months ago and I've lost 18kg. The coaches actually care about your progress — not just checking you in at the door. Best investment I've made.

testimonials.name: Stacy N.
testimonials.text: The HIIT classes with Amina are absolutely fire. I dread them and love them at the same time. Results speak for themselves — I'm in the best shape of my life at 34.

testimonials.name: David O.
testimonials.text: Clean gym, professional staff, great equipment. I've been to 4 gyms in Nairobi and Kraft is on another level. The Pro membership is completely worth it.

testimonials.name: Mercy W.
testimonials.text: Grace's yoga sessions changed how I think about fitness. After a back injury I thought I was done, but 3 months in and I'm stronger than ever. Highly recommend.

testimonials.name: Peter K.
testimonials.text: James helped me hit my first 100kg bench in 4 months. The programming is smart, the coaching is legit. This is where serious lifters come.

testimonials.name: Aisha L.
testimonials.text: I was intimidated walking in as a total beginner but the team made me feel so welcome. 8 months later I'm coaching my friends to join. Genuinely life-changing.
